phase_name: Final Safety Confirmation Before Applying DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED to Actual Measurements Design
phase_japanese_name: DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED 判定を実測適用する前の最終安全確認
purpose: Design the final safety confirmation gate that must pass before the DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED design template is applied to actual measurement results, ensuring no implementation begins prematurely and that all preconditions for real measurement execution are verified

scope_1_safety_confirmation_precondition.description: All preconditions that must be met before DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED can be applied to actual measurements

check_DC2.description: All phases from Phase 8-7 through Phase 19-9 are PASS_DESIGN_ONLY
check_DC2.pass_condition: Phase completion chain is unbroken; no phase has FAIL or PENDING status

check_SI1.description: Confirm integrated_decision is still NO_GO at the moment of this safety confirmation
check_SI1.pass_condition: integrated_decision = NO_GO (no unauthorized change since Phase 19 completion)

check_MR1.description: Phase 18-6 final ABORT verification result is still FINAL_ABORT_VERIFICATION_PASSED and has not expired
check_MR1.pass_condition: Phase 18-6 FINAL_ABORT_VERIFICATION_PASSED AND verification_timestamp + validity_window > current_utc

check_MR2.description: Phase 18-8 launch authorization signature is still active and not expired
check_MR2.pass_condition: Phase 18-8 authority_signature.revocation_status = ACTIVE AND signature_valid_to_utc > current_utc
check_MR2.fail_outcome: SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED → refresh Phase 18-8 authorization before proceeding

check_MR3.description: No significant environment changes have occurred since Phase 18 pre-execution checks were completed
check_MR3.pass_condition: Environment snapshot at Phase 18-2/18-3 still matches current environment
check_MR3.fail_outcome: SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED → re-run Phase 18-2/18-3 pre-execution checks for changed items

check_MR4.description: Phase 19-1 and 19-2 execution record templates are ready to be filled with actual measurement results
check_MR4.pass_condition: Templates present and accessible; no format errors; authority who will fill them is identified

check_HA1.description: Authorized human has explicitly approved commencement of actual Phase 15-7 measurement
check_HA1.pass_condition: Human approval recorded with authority identifier, timestamp, and digital signature
check_HA1.fail_outcome: SAFETY_GATE_BLOCKED → measurement must not begin without explicit human approval

check_HA2.description: Approving authority explicitly acknowledges that DUAL_GATE_UNLOCKED determination from Phase 19-8 is a design template and does NOT authorize implementation until actual measurements confirm GO and EFFECTIVE
check_HA2.pass_condition: Acknowledgment recorded with authority identifier and timestamp

scope_2_safety_gate_decision_logic.description: Define the decision logic for the final safety gate

rule_SG_1.next_action: Proceed to Phase 20-3 implementation start go/no-go template

rule_SG_2.condition: Any check in group_1 or group_2 fails
rule_SG_2.next_action: Do not proceed; resolve blocking condition

rule_SG_3.condition: SI1, SI2, SI3, or SI4 detects state invariant violation
rule_SG_3.next_action: Activate HALT procedure (Phase 19-6 HALT scenario 1 or 2); security investigation

rule_SG_4.condition: Any check in group_3 or group_4 fails (non-HALT)
rule_SG_4.next_action: Resolve specific blocked item(s) then re-run safety confirmation

scope_3_safety_confirmation_report_struc.description: Design the safety confirmation report document structure

section_5_safety_gate_determination.failing_checks: List of check IDs that failed (empty if CLEARED)
section_5_safety_gate_determination.next_action: Proceed to Phase 20-3 (CLEARED) OR Resolve blockers (BLOCKED) OR HALT procedure (HALT)

phase_20_2_completion_criteria: 4 precondition groups (design completeness, state invariants, measurement readiness, human authority) with 10 checks designed
4 safety gate decision rules (SG_1 through SG_4) designed
No changes to app/ or tests/ directories
